_meta.provenance: PROC-INTAKE-01. The call-rate QUARANTINE line was the SOP's 0.95, written for a different detection statistic. Measured on 48 panel arrays (12 per commissioning laboratory) with poobah p<=0.05 against each array's own negative controls: Uppsala 0.985 (min 0.979), Karolinska 0.975 (min 0.891), UCLA 0.953 (min 0.932), Munich 0.878 (max 0.928). Signal-to-background does not separate the laboratories (an Uppsala array at s2b 7.1 detects 99.4 %); the detected fraction does, with a gap 0.894 -> 0.928 -> 0.932. The author set the line at 0.93 (2026-09-27): refuses 12/12 Munich and one Karolinska array at 0.891; 0 UCLA, 0 Uppsala. These are instrument constants read by stage_0_intake; they describe the array, never a person.
_meta.author: Heath W. Mahaffey
_meta.provenance_v2: PROC-STAGE0-04 (to-do step 23). The three control-probe limits set from 337 healthy whole-blood EPIC v1 arrays of three laboratories (doors/data/PROC_STAGE0_04/stage0_healthy_epic_samples.csv: GSE318173 278, GSE315366 35, GSE184269 24), read with Stage 0 after the 2026-10-20 channel fix (each BS Conversion I pair in its own color channel) and the hybridization spread rule; per-array values in stage0_healthy_epic.csv (GitHub explore run 39611932552). Rule of the pre-registration: healthy arrays only, more than one laboratory, a percentile of the healthy distribution; each laboratory counted equally. The author chose the bisulfite line 2026-10-21.
_meta.decision_v2: bisulfite_conversion.min = 0.80 (author, 2026-10-21): the 2.5th percentile with each laboratory counted equally (0.8045); stops 1 of 337 healthy arrays (GSM5583015, 0.576, low on every pair in its own channel)
_meta.v1_kept: intake_thresholds_v1.json stays frozen as the record of the earlier limits; Stage 0 reads this file

call_rate.note: 0.93 <= call rate < 0.98 -> PROCEED_WITH_PENALTY, flag printed on the Reading tab

detection.note: per-probe detection poobah p<=0.05 against this array's negative controls; probes failing are removed before any stage reads a beta

bisulfite_conversion.metric: median over the five BS Conversion I matched pairs of C/(C+U), each pair in its own color channel

hybridization.metric: larger over smaller of the high- and low-concentration controls (green), medium between them; a swapped order is recorded, not stopped

extension.metric: green (C, G) over red (A, T) extension controls: a two-color balance
